描述_EN: laid flat and struck on the red circle with a mallet in measured beats, this version, from yunnan province, is a less abstract rendering than most temple instruments. the fish is a buddhist symbol of watchfulness, reflecting a belief that the fish never sleeps. the muyu may also be found in vocal and instrumental ensembles of guangzhouobject details this state of wakeful awareness is reinforced by the hollow sound of the muyu, a fish-shaped slit drum used to accompany buddhist chant.
描述_ZN: 平铺，用木槌在红圈上敲打，有节拍，这个版本来自云南，比大多数寺庙乐器的渲染不那么抽象。 鱼是佛教徒的守望的象征，反映了一种信念，即鱼永远不会睡觉。 在广州的声乐和器乐合奏中也可以看到木鱼的身影。 这种清醒的意识状态被木鱼的空洞声音所加强，木鱼是一种鱼形的狭长鼓，用来配合佛教的诵经。
